dimensions.evidenceA: Genesis names a man within the wrestling encounter.
dimensions.evidenceB: Hosea names an angel within its later remembrance.
dimensions.label: Figure named

dimensions.evidenceA: Jacob names the place because he says he saw God face to face.
dimensions.evidenceB: Hosea moves from angelic struggle to meeting God at Bethel.
dimensions.label: God-language

evidence.observation: Genesis calls Jacob’s opponent a man, and Jacob says he saw God face to face.
Hosea says Jacob struggled with the angel, wept, pleaded, and met God at Bethel.

record.tension: The Scripture witnesses identify Jacob’s opponent with different words while both retain God-language around the encounter.
record.title: Who is Jacob’s opponent?
